name: ethos-data-catalog
title: ETHOS.Data Catalogue
description: Tool-independent catalogue of datasets published by Forschungszentrum Julich, Institute of Climate and Energy Systems (ICE-2). Software projects reference these datasets by name rather than copying the file inventory, so a dataset used by several tools is described -- and downloaded -- exactly once.
